name: Cash Option 109
definition: Provides information about the cash option.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the value is a debit or credit.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Choice between a cash account, a charges account or a tax account.

PostingDate.name: Posting Date
PostingDate.definition: Date/Time of the posting (credit or debit) to the account.

OriginalPostingDate.name: Original Posting Date
OriginalPostingDate.definition: Date/Time of the posting (credit or debit) to the account that was initially communicated in the confirmation.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time when calculating economic benefit for a cash amount.

PostingAmount.name: Posting Amount
PostingAmount.definition: Amount of money that is to be/was posted to the account.
